notes: Access: Claude-in-Chrome only, one dedicated tab; every page and every count fetched same-origin from the loaded thebowerycompany.com context via javascript_tool fetch(). robots.txt names no Claude / anthropic-ai / ClaudeBot agent and imposes no relevant disallow (only /checkout/, /catalogsearch/ and admin paths). No block, challenge or rate-limit was encountered at any point. Tree: union of three sources per the mandatory cross-check - (a) media/sitemap/category_sitemap.xml (143 category URLs, 51 of them under /furniture), (b) the rendered mega-menu (61 furniture links), (c) each category page's own child-link block. The mega-menu UNDER-reports: the whole /furniture/beds branch (beds, daybeds, mattresses) and /furniture/sofas/poufs exist only in the sitemap. Counts: Magento server-rendered .toolbar-amount ('Items 1-20 of N' or 'N Items'), read from raw HTML, one URL at a time with ~0.7s spacing. Corroborated on three single-page categories by counting unique product tiles inside .products-grid (Outdoor Seating 17=17, Pedestals 10=10, Podiums 4=4) - the header is exact, not padded and not counting colourways. Sanity checks: the number changes per category (2086 department / 574 Tables / 700 Chairs / 116 Dining Tables), so no site-wide constant; parent totals approximate but never equal the sum of children (Tables 574 vs 560 summed, Chairs 700 vs 693, Poufs & Stools 230 vs 231), normal multi-assignment, and no parent number was copied to a child. Every leaf URL returned HTTP 200 with an h1 matching the requested slug - the one exception, /en/furniture/beds, redirects to the homepage and was therefore NOT recorded as a leaf. Slug-vs-label trap hit once: /furniture/chairs/bar-stool renders as 'Armchairs'. Duplicate-label trap hit twice: two distinct 'Outdoor Seating' categories (17 under Tables, 232 under Outdoors) and two distinct 'Poufs' (0 under Sofas, 89 under Poufs & Stools) - kept separately, keyed on slug. Excluded, with reasons: /furniture/sofas/sofa-covers (covers/protectors); /furniture/office-furniture/office-accessories (office supplies); /furniture/outdoors/outdoor-textiles and /furniture/textile* (textiles); /furniture/beds/mattresses (bedding, 0 products anyway); top-level /en/outdoor (539) - a mixed cross-department roll-up landing page with no children whose grid interleaves outdoor furniture with planters, outdoor lighting and outdoor textiles, and whose furniture content is already covered leaf-by-leaf under Furniture > Outdoors; /accessories-home/decoration-accessories/racks (9 items, inspected: 7x HAY Colour Rack S/C-shape wall-mounted coat racks plus Punctual Rack and Knit - the site files the node under Decoration & Accessories, not Furniture, and the dominant product type is a wall-mounted rack); /accessories-home/decoration-accessories/room-dividers (0 products); /accessories-home/shelves/shelving-systems (0 products) and /accessories-home/storage-furniture/storage-systems (1 item) - near-empty shadow nodes in the Accessories tree, absent from the nav, with different ids and counts from the real Furniture ones (59 and 13); /lightings/tables (1 item, lighting). Live-but-empty furniture nodes were emitted with qty 0 rather than dropped: Conference Tables, Counter Tables, Dressers, Headboards, Highboards, Sofas > Poufs and Daybeds - each verified by the site's own empty-state text.
